title: Kuro no Danshou: The Literary Fragment
overview:
Lost memories. And then... a new nightmare begins.

Kuro no Danshou: The Literary Fragment is a point-and-click mystery horror adventure for adults. Detective Satoshi Suzusaki has no memory of the night he was charged with murdering his girlfriend and three others in the United States. Six years after his return to Japan, an entire family is slaughtered in his apartment building, and a strange message left behind points to the occult and the Necronomicon.

You play Kusanagi, Satoshi's assistant and an expert in psychology, investigating a chain of killings that leads from Japan to the United States.

- One-player adventure for ages 18 and over
- Shuttle Mouse and Sega multi controller compatible
- Memory backup saves
- This limited edition comes with a bonus CD

失われた記憶。そして…
新しい悪夢が始まる。
